cut_detection.note: Candidate cuts only; user confirms boxes at each segment.

identity_policy: User assigns persistent labels at each candidate segment start; no automatic raw/boiled recognition is claimed.
loss_policy: Lost tracks are marked; coordinates are not interpolated or fabricated.
limitations: Candidate cut detection may oversegment/undersegment; manual segment boxes and lost frames require visual review. Long occlusions or identity ambiguities must be disclosed.
ai_assistance: Tracking code developed with Arena.ai; user supplies boxes, executes and reviews the full result.
